title: fix(plugin-grid): the no-data-source gate stops reading a bare `data` array as 「no adapter needed」
body:
Fixes #9580

`Clause-②: no`

`object-grid`'s 「no data source」 gate stops treating a bare `data` ARRAY as evidence that a
placement can draw rows without an adapter.

## The defect

`gridNeedsDataSource` in `packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx` enumerates the escape hatches that let
THIS placement draw rows without a runtime adapter, and `Array.isArray(schema.data)` was one of
them. Both carriers of that shorthand had already been retired:

- objectui#8348 (「8348 以协议为准」, decision batch #83) at the shared record-source ladder — this
  block's published `data` row is the `ViewData` OBJECT arm;
- objectui#9571 (ruling objectui#8348 Q2-C, batch #136 item 3, maintainer 「同意」) at the props
  channel — `SchemaRenderer` no longer spreads an authored `data` as a React prop for a block on
  that arm.

⇒ an authored array draws **nothing**, while the predicate still answered 「this placement needs no
adapter」. So a grid authored with a bare `data` array, an `objectName` and no adapter rendered the
EMPTY SHELL that objectui#5378 item 2 exists to replace, with the one diagnostic addressed to exactly
that situation staying silent. The warn-once objectui#9571 added at the strip site is `__DEV__`-only;
this gate is the production-facing half.

⛔ The bare-array CARRIER is **not** re-opened — that was ruled twice. Only what the gate SAYS moves.

## The change

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx` — one line removed from the predicate
  (`Array.isArray(schema?.data)`), and the docblock that enumerates the hatches re-derived: it had
  also carried the now-false clause that `getDataConfig` folds an array `data` into inline rows.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridNeedsDataSourceBareArray-9580.test.tsx` — the pin, 8 rows.
- `.changeset/9580-grid-needs-datasource-bare-array.md` — `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-grid`; the
  behaviour of a published block moves, so this is not a `skip-changeset` change.

## Premises re-verified on `origin/main` before writing anything

The card is written in the conditional (「After objectui#9571 lands」). Re-taken on
`f0b49792159de76697b06109bfe7760938e463a0`, which is this branch's base and was `origin/main` at
branch time:

| Premise | Reading |
|---|---|
| `SchemaRenderer` no longer spreads an authored `data` for a `view-data`-arm block | TRUE — the strip is live in `SchemaRenderer.tsx`, gated on `'data' in componentProps && recordSourceDataArmForType(type) === 'view-data'` |
| `gridNeedsDataSource` still returned false for `Array.isArray(schema?.data)` | TRUE — the line was present in `packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`, unmoved |
| objectui#9571's mitigation is `__DEV__`-only | TRUE — the strip site calls `reportRefusedDataPropSpread` under `if (__DEV__)`, and that function's own docblock says 「Read-only and `__DEV__`-only」 |

⇒ the defect exists as written; `premise_still_valid: true`.

## The pin can go red — measured, not asserted

The repair was committed first, then the removed line was planted back through
`ablation-replace.mjs` (literal anchor, hit count declared, write verified against the DISK and
against `git hash-object`, restore proven by blob-equals-HEAD plus an empty `git diff HEAD`).
Predicted direction before running: 转红 — rows 1-2 fail, every control holds.

```
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob b0c0adeb7cc4 -> d9f649b0cf7a
  × 1. REPRODUCTION: bare `data` array + `objectName` + no adapter => the gate FIRES   1067ms
  × 2. ...and it says the sentence the family says, naming THIS block and object       1015ms
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  2 failed | 6 passed (8)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (b0c0adeb7cc4) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

With the repair in place the same file is `Tests 8 passed (8)`. The ablation runs entirely against
SOURCE — the root vitest config aliases `@object-ui/react` to `packages/react/src` and the block
itself is imported relatively — so there is no `dist/` leg for it to be true-but-unbuilt in.

Rows 3-8 are the controls that a repair reaching too far would break: the declared
`data: { provider: 'value', items: [...] }` form, the deprecated `staticData` array, the data-scope
`bind`, the `data` REACT PROP a host such as `plugin-list`'s `ListView` uses to hand down rows it
already fetched (the leg objectui#9571 deliberately kept), the `objectName` clause, and a grid that
HAS an adapter.

## Local verification

Gate list hand-derived from this repo's `package.json` and `.github/workflows/` —
`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` lives only in `objectstack` and refuses to answer for this repo.
Exit codes were redirected to files and read from there, never from a pipeline's tail.

| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-view/ packages/plugin-list/` | exit 0 — `Test Files 120 passed (120)`, `Tests 1342 passed (1342)` |

| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid run type-check` | exit 0 — both legs (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the first EXCLUDES `__tests__`, which is why the second is the one that reads the new pin) |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid run lint` | exit 0 — 841 warnings, 0 errors (all pre-existing `no-explicit-any` / react-hooks advisories) |

| `check-sdui-registration-pins` | **NOT MEASURED** — exit 2, prerequisite not met: it needs an `apps/console` bundle to weigh. Owned by `performance-budget.yml`, which builds the console first. No registration array moved in this diff. |
| repo-wide `pnpm lint` / full `pnpm test` | left to CI — the affected package's own `lint` and the three suites above are the narrowed substitute, declared here rather than skipped silently |

Byte scan beyond the gate: `grep -naP '[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]'` over both changed source
files returns nothing.

## Acceptance notes

⚠️ Out of scope, noted and NOT filed — `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is outside this
card's declared file surface, so it is untouched here. Its `getDataConfig` docblock still states as a
MEASURED conclusion that an authored `data` array reaches the component TWICE and that 「through
`SchemaRenderer` an authored `data: [ ...rows... ]` still draws, from the props channel」. objectui#9571
made both halves false, and the pin that paragraph cites — row 3 of
`__tests__/gridBareArrayDataRefused-8348.test.tsx` — now asserts the opposite in the same tree. It is
prose drift rather than one of the three filing classes, so no card is raised from here; per
AGENTS.md it is the kind of thing the next change to that file repairs opportunistically. Named
handler: none. Dedupe terms if a seat does decide to file it: `getDataConfig` · `passedData` ·
`two carriers` · `props channel` · `objectui#9571 docblock drift`.
